purpose: Fixed native circulation/humidity reference for six diagnostic reruns. New Mexico subset; old India/PNW inputs read-only. No climate tuning or adoption.
reference: NOAA PSL NCEP/NCAR monthly climatology 1981–2010, 2.5 degree native grid; model-assisted reanalysis, not independent validation
matching: Gregorian no-leap interval overlap; native inmap footprints >=80% covered; land/ocean >=80%; 925hPa above terrain in reference and model. Empty masks remain empty. Matched 925–300hPa model integral uses actual simultaneous layer water and winds; observed flux uses products of monthly means and omits submonthly covariance.
below_ground_fallback: None. Report excluded coverage; do not substitute terrain levels after seeing results.
